note_title: 函数傅里叶展开的Dini判别及其应用

callouts.id: 函数傅里叶展开的Dini判别及其应用#1
callouts.title: Dini判别(1880)
callouts.body: $f\in L^{1}([0,T))$是实变量的周期为$T$的函数，并且对于$x_0 \in [0,T)$存在正实数$\delta>0$使得函数满足$$\int_{|t|\leq \delta} \left |\frac{f(x_0-t)-f(x_0)}{t}\right | \,dm(t) < +\infty$$那么此函数的傅里叶级数在此点收敛到函数本身。

classification_result.id: 函数傅里叶展开的Dini判别及其应用#1

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $f\in L^{1}([0,T))$ be a real-valued periodic function of period $T$. Suppose that for $x_0 \in [0,T)$ there exists a positive real number $\delta>0$ such that
$$\int_{|t|\leq \delta} \left |\frac{f(x_0-t)-f(x_0)}{t}\right | \,dm(t) < +\infty.$$ 
Then the Fourier series of $f$ converges to $f(x_0)$ at the point $x_0$.
key_techniques: local integral regularity near a point
prerequisites: pointwise convergence criteria for Fourier series
